game.title: Neon Lanes
game.objective: Drive as far as possible down a neon highway, dodging pink X-blocks and jumping over orange barriers while collecting yellow coins.
game.controls: Swipe left or right to switch lanes, swipe up to jump over barriers, and tap on-screen buttons to revive or play.
game.core_loop: Swipe to switch lanes or jump -> dodge obstacles and grab yellow coins -> build distance and speed for higher scores.
features: Milestone and combo callouts (GREAT JUMP!, 50 COINS!)
game.progression: Speed steadily ramps up from SPD 51 to SPD 84 as distance increases, with denser obstacle patterns and milestone banners.
game.hook_idea: The Magnet power-up frenzy at t=19.0-21.0s where coins fly into the car at high speed while weaving past pink X-blocks.
